title: LEARN GLOBALLY, SPEAK LOCALLY: BRIDGING THE GAPS IN MULTILINGUAL REASONING

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring language consistency by using language identification tools to check if the generated reasoning traces match the language of the prompt, assessing the tendency of models to default to high-resource languages like English when queried in low-resource languages.

Evaluating factual accuracy and reasoning quality on the GEOFACT-X benchmark, which consists of culturally grounded questions localized to five specific countries, and comparing performance between associative and non-associative language-country pairs.
